tasks.label: iOS: Run CameraAccess on Connected iPhone
tasks.command:
set -euo pipefail

DEVICE_ID="$(xcrun xctrace list devices | sed -n '/== Devices ==/,/== Simulators ==/p' | sed -nE '/iPhone/s/.*\(([0-9A-F-]+)\)$/\1/p' | head -n 1)"

if [[ -z "${DEVICE_ID}" ]]; then
  echo "No connected physical iPhone found. Connect and unlock your iPhone, then trust this Mac."
  exit 1
fi

echo "Using device: ${DEVICE_ID}"

xcodebuild \
  -project CameraAccess.xcodeproj \
  -scheme CameraAccess \
  -configuration Debug \
  -destination "id=${DEVICE_ID}" \
  -derivedDataPath .vscode/DerivedData \
  -allowProvisioningUpdates \
  build

APP_PATH="${PWD}/.vscode/DerivedData/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos/CameraAccess.app"

if [[ ! -d "${APP_PATH}" ]]; then
  echo "Build succeeded but app bundle not found at: ${APP_PATH}"
  exit 1
fi

BUNDLE_ID="$(/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c 'Print :CFBundleIdentifier' "${APP_PATH}/Info.plist")"

echo "Installing app on device..."
xcrun devicectl device install app --device "${DEVICE_ID}" "${APP_PATH}"

echo "Launching ${BUNDLE_ID}..."
xcrun devicectl device process launch --device "${DEVICE_ID}" --terminate-existing "${BUNDLE_ID}"
